limitations.quote: Applies when a flag derived from an FSM state or counter value asserts on the wrong clock
limitations.note: The guides covered FSM, counter, and word-completion timing rather than detecting both transitions of a synchronized toggle, and they did not change the fix.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: Two workspace probes failed to locate the guides before the agent used their supplied path, and the rejected cleanup command forced it to resubmit the test unchanged.
